periods.time: vol-10 ch-002, late night before the semifinals

name.zh: 月影告知一辉天宫紫音的过去
name.en: Tsukikage tells Ikki Amamiya Shion's past

periods.summary: After Stella leaves, Prime Minister Bakuya Tsukikage appears and asks Ikki to hear something about Amane. Ikki refuses at first because any interaction may be part of Amane's causality, but Tsukikage says Ikki is unlikely to fight Amane at all in the current state. Tsukikage reveals Amane's original name, Amamiya Shion, and the life story that made him abandon himself. He asks Ikki to use the secret to provoke Amane into fighting because Amane's withdrawal would trouble Akatsuki.
periods.cause: Tsukikage predicts Amane will withdraw from the semifinal to taint Ikki's final rather than fight normally.
periods.outcome: Ikki gains the information needed to expose Amane's true motive, while also suspecting Tsukikage may be manipulating both sides.
periods.significance: Provides the key to Amane's psychology and hints at Tsukikage's unrevealed ability and motives.
